# SCP-096 asset sources

## Character

SCP-096 ("The Shy Guy") is a concept of the SCP Foundation wiki: "SCP-096" by Dr Dan,
<https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-096>, licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0. The model, texture and clips below are
**own work** generated by scripts in this repository from the written description (pale, emaciated, about 2.4 m
tall, very long arms, small hairless head, black empty eyes, a huge jaw). No model, texture or image of SCP:
Containment Breach or of the wiki was downloaded, traced or converted. As depictions of a CC BY-SA 3.0 concept,
these files are shared under CC BY-SA 3.0 as well.

| Committed files | Generator | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `geo/scp096/scp096.geo.json`, `textures/entity/scp096/scp096.png.b64` | `tools/assets/scp096_model.py` (`chitauri_lib.py`, `jinwoo_geo.py`) | 25 bones / 68 cubes, separate jaw, jointed fingers; procedural 256×256 atlas (ribs, spine, dried blood on the hands and mouth) |
| `animations/scp096/scp096_{calm,rage,chase}.animation.json` | `tools/assets/scp096_anims.py` | 19 clips: sit, sit_peek, sob (additive), stand, cover, walk, stand_up, sit_down, gaze, gaze_sit, hysteria, rise, calm, run, rage, leap, climb, smash, attack (upper body). Hands on the face and planted feet are IK-solved; every key rotation is rewritten to a continuous Euler branch (`tidy`) |

Paths are relative to `viltrumitecore/src/main/resources/assets/viltrumitecore/` (model, clips) and
`viltrumitecore/src/main/binassets/assets/viltrumitecore/` (texture).

## Sounds

### The mod's own sounds (issue #136)

A clean install plays the mod's own SCP-096 sounds (`viltrumitecore/src/main/binassets/assets/viltrumitecore/sounds/scp096/`,
events in `src/main/sound-overlays/scp096.json`), built by `python3 tools/sfx/scp096.py` (fetch: `--fetch`, listen:
`--wav <dir>`):

| Event | File(s) | How it is made |
|---|---|---|
| `scp096.cry` | `cry` (22 s loop) | a man's broken, high sobbing: two cries and two whimpers raised a little, a breathy ghostly layer far behind, small reverb |
| `scp096.angered` | `angered` (12 s loop) | a hysteric weeping scream at four pitches over a crying girl and a crying man, softly saturated: wailing that never pauses |
| `scp096.scream` | `scream` (10 s loop) | a shrieking voice, a screaming man, a monster screech, a demonic scream and horror shrieks stacked and saturated |
| `scp096.triggered` | `triggered` | a reversed screech sucked in, then a synthesised sub boom, a dissonant string-cluster stab and the screech forward |
| `scp096.chase_music` | `chase_music` (26.5 s loop) | own composition, written note by note in `scp096.py` (16 bars, 145 bpm, D minor: low drums, chromatic bass ostinato, trembling string cluster, high dissonance) |
| `scp096.strike` | `strike_1..3` | power kick, body smack, bone crunch and a heavy punch |
| `scp096.smash` | `smash_1..3` | wood smash at three pitches over a low thump and a crunch, glass breaking in two of them |
| `scp096.leap` | `leap_1..2` | a big whoosh, then a heavy barefoot stamp and a low landing thump |

The loops are seamless (cross-faded wrap) and stream continuously (`Scp096ClientSounds`); the old vanilla
one-shot fallback is gone. Recordings used (all **CC0 1.0** on Freesound, downloaded with their licence checked by
`tools/sfx/fslib.py`):

### The originals: never committed

The five sounds that make SCP-096 recognisable come from **SCP – Containment Breach** (Regalis11/scpcb). The game
is published under CC BY-SA 3.0 according to its README, but the authorship of these particular files is unclear
or third-party:

| Event | File in an SCP: CB install | What we know |
|---|---|---|
| `scp096.cry` | `SFX/Music/096.ogg` | crying loop; credited elsewhere to Omniary and FragdaddyXXL, not in the game's credits |
| `scp096.angered` | `SFX/Music/096Angered.ogg` | wailing loop while it is triggered; author unknown |
| `scp096.scream` | `SFX/SCP/096/Scream.ogg` | chase scream loop; an edit by FireFox described as "for SCP: CB only" |
| `scp096.triggered` | `SFX/SCP/096/Triggered.ogg` | sting when the face is seen; same as above |
| `scp096.chase_music` | `SFX/Music/096Chase.ogg` | chase music; "Hush" by Kevin MacLeod (CC BY), as edited for the game |

Because redistribution rights are not clear for every file, **no SCP: CB audio is committed** and the jar contains
none (`Scp096AssetsTest.noContainmentBreachAudioIsCommitted` forbids the SCP: CB file names and any
`sounds/scp096/original/` file). Instead, the client builds a built-in resource pack
from the player's **own local copy** of the game at start-up (`client/scp096/Scp096OriginalSounds`,
`Scp096OriginalPack`):

- search order: config `scp096OriginalSoundsPath`, `<gameDir>/viltrumitecore/scp096/`, then folders that look like
  an SCP: CB install under the home folder (Desktop, Downloads, Games, Documents), Steam libraries and
  `C:/`/`D:/` program folders (one directory listing each, no recursive scan);
- accepted layouts: the game tree (`SFX/Music/096.ogg`), flat names (`096.ogg`) or flattened paths
  (`SFX_Music_096.ogg`); files are checked for the Ogg signature and a sane size, nothing is converted or copied;
- the pack "SCP-096: original SCP: CB sounds" replaces only the events it found (`replace: true`, `stream: true`);
  positional loops are stereo files, so `MonoDownmixStream` averages them to mono on the fly (OpenAL attenuates
  and pans mono sources only);
- `tools/scp096/install_original_sounds.py "<SCP-CB folder>" <gameDir>` copies the five files from a local
  installation into `<gameDir>/viltrumitecore/scp096/`.
- **One-step opt-in official download:** `python3 tools/scp096/download_original_sounds.py viltrumitecore/run`
  (or substitute your Minecraft game directory). This obtains the exact five game Ogg files straight from
  `Regalis11/scpcb` at pinned commit `edb8fe0840b78f14d1aef3a0bf6174630e7be296`. Every file's size, Ogg
  signature and Git blob SHA1 are verified before being atomically installed to the same local directory. It
  never overwrites existing, different audio; restart Minecraft or press F3+T to reload.
  Downloading is explicitly initiated by the user, never silently performed when the mod loads.

Without the originals the mod's own sounds above play (before #136 they were vanilla Minecraft events). With them,
only the five events found are replaced; strike, smash and leap always stay the mod's own.

Playback follows SCP: CB (`NPCs.bb`): the cry loop is heard within ~8 game units (here 20 blocks, linear), the
wailing within ~10 (40 blocks), the scream within 7.5 (56 blocks, it is a city); the sting is not positional and
zooms the camera in; the chase music plays only for the hunted player at `min(max(8 - d, 0.6), 1)` volume (here
1.0 near, 0.6 far or unseen) with the 7.2 s camera pulse. Subtitles for the four creature sounds exist in all 12
locales (`src/main/lang-overlays/scp096/`); the music has none.
